title: Madame Bovary
author: Gustave Flaubert
summary: Emma Bovary, married to a kind but dull country doctor, longs for the romance and luxury she has read about. Her affairs and her spending slowly trap her in debt and disillusion.
readIf: you appreciate precise, ironic prose and a close study of a woman who wants more than she is given.
skipIf: you want likeable characters or a hopeful ending.

pairings.reason: A larger Russian novel that also follows a married woman who falls into an affair, with more sympathy.
Another novel about the damage done by chasing a dream of glamour.
